title: neon arcade?
content: for years i’ve been in mall world and i find myself going into this arcade that has neon floors with stars and u almost can rollerskate through it. this was always the last place id get to before a movie theater and then a weird back room type of place with pastel colors like pink and blue. im also new to the community and i wanted to know if anyone experience those moving walkways in the airports instead of escalators?
